name: Santa Fe County, NM
findings: Santa Fe County has 915 nonprofit organizations. 418 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 334 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Santa Fe County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Santa Fe County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 40 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Foundation organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 23 foundation organizations here list public events, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do foundation organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
